authorInfo.bio: Oscar Wilde was an Irish writer celebrated for his wit, fairy tales and plays. The Picture of Dorian Gray is his only novel. His other works include The Importance of Being Earnest, The Happy Prince and The Ballad of Reading Gaol, spanning comedy, beauty and painful reflection.

sourceTitle: Children in Prison and Other Cruelties of Prison Life
description: "Children in Prison and Other Cruelties of Prison Life" by Oscar Wilde is a poignant letter and critical commentary written in the late 19th century. This work falls under the category of social criticism and reform literature, focusing on the treatment of children within the prison system.
